Status: Approved. Last reviewed 2026-09-14. Owner: Rahul Mehta.

Describes the SAP to Snowflake data flow through MuleSoft and Salesforce.

### Salesforce CRM
Salesforce CRM is hosted on the vendor-hosted SaaS tenant. Salesforce CRM integrates with Collections Manager using api. Salesforce CRM calls Customer 360 Feature API.

SAP S/4HANA Finance integrates with MuleSoft Anypoint using api.
MuleSoft Anypoint integrates with Salesforce CRM using api.
Salesforce CRM integrates with Snowflake Data Cloud using event.
